Name: Day Randomizer
Author: SwellWaters
Description:
[b]Install:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install GMCM here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Main features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Generates random days using Stardew's weather formula[/b][/*]
[*]Makes the Community Center a MUCH harder challenge[/*]
[*]Shows Stats for all of the days of a run[/*]
[*]Possibility to unlock tomorrows weather forecast for a hefty fee [/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/*]
[*]GMCM for easy configurability.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility: [/b]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on Linux/Mac/Windows.[/*]
[/list][b]Tips & Bug Reporting:[/b]
https://discord.gg/9673wVQsF
